name: times_table
description: Single-digit by 1-2 digit multiplication (a in 2..9, b in 2..19), few-shot 'a x b = c'. Control: same format, answer copies the larger operand ('larger of a and b is ...').
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
def make(ctrl,n=120):
    out=[]
    for _ in range(n):
        shots=[(random.randint(2,9),random.randint(2,19)) for _ in range(3)]
        a,b=random.randint(2,9),random.randint(2,19)
        if ctrl:
            p="".join(f"larger of {x} and {y} is {max(x,y)}\n" for x,y in shots)+f"larger of {a} and {b} is"; ans=f" {max(a,b)}"
        else:
            p="".join(f"{x} x {y} = {x*y}\n" for x,y in shots)+f"{a} x {b} ="; ans=f" {a*b}"
        out.append({"prompt":p,"answer":ans})
    return out
json.dump({"items":make(False),"control":make(True)},open("/work/skill.json","w"))
